# Country scope. May raise Stratiotai.
oe_levy_is_stratiotai_country = {
	oe_main_mod_old_world_event_allowed = yes
	OR = {
		tag = BYZ tag = ROM tag = TRE tag = EPI
		culture ?= {
			OR = { has_culture_group = culture_group:greek_group }
		}
	}
}
